chapters.label: The run, live
chapters.text: Yokohama, 2002, the World Cup final. Brazil lead Germany, seventy-three minutes gone... and Cafu is still running! The captain races down the right wing, past his man... and crosses for Rivaldo. So close!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. A defender, flying up the wing like an attacker, still sprinting late in the final.

chapters.label: The captain
chapters.text: Brazil won, two-nil. As the rain came down, Cafu jumped onto a podium and lifted the World Cup to the sky.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: full-backs, defend and attack. Get back, then run forward. Keep running the whole game!
